CR_UC_CLINICAL_RESPONSE.justification: No structured observation records were found for this patient documenting ulcerative colitis clinical response or disease activity improvement from baseline (stool frequency, rectal bleeding, urgency, CRP, fecal calprotectin, mucosal appearance, Mayo score, or UCEIS).
